title: Anchor relative reminder times to the request time
goal: "in 2 minutes" is due 2 minutes after the owner asked, however long the model rounds take
acceptance: A committed test fails first: "in 2 minutes" with a model due anchored to a later step is stored at request time + 2 minutes (English and Italian, minutes and hours)
Misato's prompt "Now" is the request time (sortie created, or when an answer to her question arrived)
Clock times, dates and parts of day keep their current handling
privacy: Neutral invented reminders only; live evidence read with sqlite3 -readonly.
escalation: A change to how Misato's prompt describes time beyond the request anchor goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: read the sortie evidence, a deterministic relative-time rule, the request time through coordinator, brain and executors, and a failing-first test. Not a measurement.
